title: Qualification state: exact receipt-backed evidence and explicit external-library skips
summary: Native Database Backends v0.3.2 has an Autobuild PASS receipt for the canonical selector/capability/bulk/fallback/wire-boundary suite. The Autobuild host lacks libpq.so.5/libpq.so, so the two live-libpq-dependent tests are explicitly ENVIRONMENT_SKIPPED and no fresh live libpq or PostgreSQL server qualification is claimed. Rexx/SQL SQLite v0.1.1 separately has an Autobuild PASS receipt covering driver/backend/provider gates and SSC live suites. Historical evidence, current receipts, and the unreconciled Library v0.3.4 head remain distinct.
invariants: Never turn retained inherited tests into newly executed evidence when dependency roots were unavailable.
Deterministic fake-provider tests qualify projection and planner logic, not a live remote database connection.
Current roll-up availability does not equal compatibility qualification.
Non-claims remain first-class evidence until the implementation and tests exist.
Qualification must name runtime and exact companion versions/digests where material.
A Git source increment marked ready for Autobuild is not runtime-qualified until the exact submission receipt is recorded.
